temporary-employment-model-matlab-struct.title: Temporary employment regulation model: MATLAB code structure for thresholds and job stocks (2023-11-08)
temporary-employment-model-matlab-struct.content: As of 2023-11-08, the user is developing MATLAB code for a research model titled 'Temporary Employment, Firm Heterogeneity and Regulation'. Per user-provided code: lambdap(i) = (y(i) - r*U - r*cc)/(cc + fc) for each productivity value y; lambdat(i) is solved numerically via csolve on eval_lambdat(lambda, cc, U, fc, r, y(i)); stockP(i) = integral over [1e-8, lambdap(i)] of (1/lambda) .* jobsP, where jobsP = G(lambdap(i), dscale, dshape) - G(1e-8, dscale, dshape); stockT(i) = integral over [lambdap(i), lambdat(i)] of (1/lambda) .* log(y(i)/(r*U)) .* jobsT, where jobsT = G(lambdat(i), dscale, dshape) - G(lambdap(i), dscale, dshape). G is the CDF of the distribution of shock arrival rates; the code draft selects the Weibull law. The code draft also computes a conversion threshold lambdas via fzero on eval_lambdas and uses r_annual = 0.05 (converted to a daily rate), log-normal productivity (mu = log(1.57), sigma = 0.1, n = 10000 draws), U = 1/r, and pre-decided values dscale = 0.02, dshape = 1.1, fc = 50, cc = 0.0020 (parameter values per the rewritten code draft, not independently confirmed by the user).
